name: Projects template-driven publishing
statement: Users can turn curated Atlas data into coherent, attractive publications using existing links, text, media and recorded relationships without training an AI.
requiredProperties: Top-level Projects workspace separate from source Catalogs
Template picker and deterministic editable draft generation
Image-linked bookmarks display under the related image by default
Preserve original notes/captions and user-editable titles
Include/exclude content, customize ordering and link placement
Approved static website export with responsive/accessibility/privacy safeguards

provenance.sourceReference: Owner Atlas Projects and multi-folder bookmarks requests, 2026-10-15
